title: astyposanthes subviscosa
intro: Astyposanthes subviscosa, commonly known as the "Sri Lankan gentian", is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It has been found to have various health benefits, including its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Astyposanthes subviscosa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicrin and amarogentin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
